name: Common Room
description: Embed complete buyer intelligence directly within Claude. Research accounts and contacts, surface buying signals, and browse activity history - all through natural language. Build prospect lists of net-new companies by industry, size, tech stack, or location. Filter and sort contacts by segment, role, lead score, or website visits. Every result is grounded in real context, real prioritization, and real revenue opportunity directly from your CRM fields, scores, enrichment, and signals - so you always know what's actually happening in your accounts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Common Room to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Common Room to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.commonroom.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Common Room MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common Room provides these MCP tools: commonroom_get_catalog, commonroom_list_objects, commonroom_create_object, commonroom_update_object, and commonroom_submit_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Common Room?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Common Room in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Common Room MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common Room requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Common Room is developed by Common Room. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
